correctness.rationale: Pointwise single-coordinate decrement criterion gives unique labeling for each defender set and requires an adjacent private zero for every 2. On a cycle this is exactly the cyclic no-consecutive-short-gaps rule. Two-state transfer matrix trace-log yields the rational bivariate generating function, with n/k accounting exactly for labeled cycles and periodic patterns. Marked block counts prove the binomial coefficient formula; n<=3|S|+|V1| and all-long j-gap constructions prove exact full support. Direct full 3^n brute force n=3..11, independent full 2^n defender sets n=3..18, exact coefficient n=3..45 and support n=3..65 agree. Boundary n=3, single defender and all-one configurations addressed.

value.rationale: A complete weighted enumeration of all pointwise-minimal Roman dominating functions is a natural refinement of active minimal-RDF enumeration research and of the earlier all-RDF Roman cycle polynomial. It specifies every possible weight, exact nonnegative coefficients and labelled multiplicities, not just an extremal value or arbitrary slice. The private-neighbor cyclic composition gives reusable structural insight. It also identifies which scalar numerical sequence was known long before, preventing an artificial novelty claim; bivariate coefficients encode strictly more than this known total.
